import Part, FreeCADGui as Gui
from pathlib import Path
out = Path('/Users/liushurui/Desktop/cad_mcp/freecad-nexus/examples/output')
doc = App.ActiveDocument
Gui.activeDocument().activeView().fitAll()
Gui.updateGui()
Gui.activeDocument().activeView().saveImage(str(out / 'inspection-actuator.png'), 1600, 1000, 'White')
exported = [doc.getObject(n) for n in ['Frame', 'Ram']]
assert all(o.Shape.isValid() and len(o.Shape.Solids) > 0 for o in exported)
Part.export(exported, str(out / 'inspection-actuator.step'))
expected = {o.Name: o.Shape.Volume for o in exported}
filename = str(out / 'inspection-actuator.FCStd')
doc.recompute()
doc.saveAs(filename)
App.closeDocument(doc.Name)
doc = App.openDocument(filename)
for name, volume in expected.items():
    obj = doc.getObject(name)
    assert obj.Shape.isValid() and abs(obj.Shape.Volume - volume) < max(1e-5, volume * 1e-8)
_result_ = {'cad': 'inspection-actuator.FCStd', 'step': 'inspection-actuator.step', 'image': 'inspection-actuator.png', 'saved_reopened': True, 'volumes_mm3': expected}
